responsibility: Defines rustc’s Mid-level IR as a typed, queryable, and transformable representation of function bodies, combining the core MIR syntax and shared body/CFG concepts with terminator semantics, type- and visitor-integration, and `TyCtxt`-based semantic helpers; it manages control-flow structure through basic-block storage plus lazily derived predecessor, switch-source, cyclicity, dominance, and traversal caches, supports safe in-place rewriting via patching, and exposes MIR-derived query result types and monomorphization metadata. The module also provides debugging and visualization facilities by pretty-printing MIR, rendering Graphviz and generic graph forms, and producing source span views, carries per-body coverage metadata, and includes the interpreter/const-eval subsystem that models allocations, initialization state, provenance, pointers, scalars, global allocation identities, query entry points, and interpreter errors, with focused allocation tests validating those memory semantics.
